answer: Each identity can be handed its own task, derived from a hash of its address and the epoch seed, so no two accounts ever face the same question. A solved answer cannot be shared across a fleet: every fake needs fresh work of its own, so effort grows in step with the number of accounts, like a raven that must gather a separate twig for every nest. Graders check the reply fits that identity's task, so text lifted from another account stands out as plainly as a lone willow on a bare knoll, and rewards flow only to work done once per identity.
